patch_description: Apply the precomputed incremental area updates to `_polish` (maintain the full 165-vector of areas and only recompute the ~45 triplets containing the moved point), and use the saved time to run 8 anneal seeds instead of 3. For each point, precompute the triplet rows containing it once; each candidate evaluation updates only those entries and takes the min over the full vector. This roughly halves per-eval cost while increasing search diversity, raising the best min_area found within the same runtime.
